result.markdown: --- title: "Week 10: Multiple regression and forecasting" --- ::: {.cell} ::: ## What you will learn this week * Useful predictors for time series forecasting using regression * Selecting predictors * Ex ante and ex post forecasting ## Pre-class activities Read [Chapter 7 of the textbook](https://otexts.com/fpp3/regression.html) and watch all embedded videos ## Tutorial exercises ::: {.callout-note} ## Tutorial Learning Objectives ::: - Complete Exercises 1-7 from [Section 7.10 of the book](https://otexts.com/fpp3/regression-exercises.html). ## Assignments * [IA4](../assignments/A4.qmd) is due on Friday 15 May. * [GA4](../assignments/G4.qmd) is due on Tuesday 26 May. ## Weekly quiz * Week 10 quiz: [ETF3231](https://learning.monash.edu/mod/quiz/view.php?id=5400156) | [ETF5231](https://learning.monash.edu/mod/quiz/view.php?id=5402244) — Due Wednesday 13 May.
